name: gog-skills
description: Read and modify Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, Docs) from the terminal via the `gog` CLI.

plugins.name: gog-skills
plugins.description: Drive `gog`, the Google Workspace CLI — Gmail (search/send), Calendar (events), Drive (search), Contacts, Sheets (get/update/append/clear), Docs (export/cat). Covers OAuth client setup, multi-account, scripting flags, and the keyring/env-source gotcha.
